ofertas.nome: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 GLOBAL MATCH
ofertas.descricao: KOF ’97 is the final entry in the Orochi Saga, the original storyline of the KOF series, which is still played by enthusiastic fans around the world. KOF ’97 makes a return with new features such as online matchmaking, a new gallery mode, and custom menu BGM settings!

For The King is a strategic RPG that blends tabletop and roguelike elements in a challenging adventure that spans the realms. Set off on a single player experience or play cooperatively both online and locally.

Em meio à Guerra das Coroas, há cavaleiros e saqueadores por todo reino, espalhando destruição. Da sua base no castelo, torne-se o lorde que lidera o combate contra as forças do mal neste jogo de estratégia e tática em turnos.
Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.

Build and expand your repair service empire in this incredibly detailed and highly realistic simulation game, where attention to car detail is astonishing. Find classic, unique cars in the new Barn Find module and Junkyard module. You can even add your self-made car in the Car Editor.

ofertas.nome: THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002 UNLIMITED MATCH
ofertas.descricao: KOF 2002 UM is the 2nd title in the UM Series and a fully upgraded ver. of KOF 2002, a masterpiece of the KOF Series deserving its place of honor alongside KOF ’98. Based on THE NESTS CHRONICLES, 2002 UM includes the most characters of any title in the KOF Series, and fighting game history!
The Ultimate Vault Hunter’s Upgrade lets you get the most out of the Borderlands 2 experience.

This is a martial arts action role-playing game. The core of the game is battle-oriented, and it combines many fighting elements. If you are a player who pursues blood and is brave enough to challenge the limits, it will definitely inspire your adrenaline and bring you the best combat experience.

Enfrenta os 13 ralis do WRC e os seus cenários recriados com toda a fidelidade. Joga com os melhores pilotos no Campeonato ao volante dos seus novos carros. Sozinho ou online, enfrenta os Epic Stages, participa em desafios semanais e vive a experiência do WRC como um pro!

ofertas.nome: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
ofertas.descricao: The adventure plunges you into the tortured and hidden past of five humans. Delve into their darkest fears. Outwit the Master Computer AM in a game of psychological warfare. Disturbing, compelling. An adventure you won't easily forget !!
Torne-se o melhor ladrão. Reúna informações, roube objetos e os venda para comprar equipamentos de alta tecnologia. Faça tudo que um verdadeiro ladrão faz

Become a Wayfinder, and unlock their powers as you choose your path and playstyle while pushing back a hostile force that has overtaken your world. A Co-Op ARPG where you directly shape and customize the endless adventures you go on with friends, because Wayfinders are stronger together.

In KILLING FLOOR 2, players descend into continental Europe after it has been overrun by horrific, murderous clones called Zeds that were created by rogue elements of the Horzine Corporation. 6-player Co-Op & 12-player VS Zed-slaughtering mayhem.

ofertas.nome: Flashing Lights - Police, Firefighting, Emergency Services (EMS) Simulator
ofertas.descricao: Play solo or in up to 10-player multiplayer co-op! Flashing Lights is an open world police, firefighting and EMS simulator game with plenty of opportunity for role-play or more relaxed fun with friends. Become the law or save lives! Discover leagues of player-created mods!

Transforma um pequeno terreno numa fortuna, semente a semente. Cultiva, vende na tua loja e reinveste tudo o que ganhares. Melhores ferramentas, mais terreno, colheitas mais ricas. Descontração da primeira semente ao último campo.

Owlboy is a story-driven platform adventure game, where you can fly and explore a brand new world in the clouds! Pick up your friends, and bring them with you as you explore the open skies, in one of the most detailed adventures of this era.

In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.

ofertas.nome: You Suck at Parking® - Complete Edition
ofertas.descricao: You Suck at Parking® is the only racing game where your goal is to stop and parking your ride is more important than your driving skills. It’s a hot race against the clock as you drift, cruise, and go airborne over 250 frustratingly fun, wild levels.

ofertas.nome: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '98 ULTIMATE MATCH FINAL EDITION
ofertas.descricao: After “KOF '98”, often praised by the fans as the best installment in the “KOF” series, and “KOF ’98 UM” 10 years later, “KOF ’98” returns now on the Steam PC gaming platform in an ultimate and final version with THE KING OF FIGHTERS ’98 ULTIMATE MATCH FINAL EDITION

For when I weep, then I am strong. Battle through Purgatory as Rei to help save her sister in this Action RPG. Switch freely between four playable characters, and uncover each one of their pasts to see the sorrows they have endured.

A simulação do WRC mais completa e autêntica de sempre. Novo sistema de física para todas as superfícies, um modo de carreira completamente remodelado, condições meteorológicas dinâmicas, 50 equipas, 14 países, 100 pistas, desafios semanais e um modo eSports…

ofertas.nome: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
ofertas.descricao: Descobre o “shooter-looter” cooperativo original repleto de novos melhoramentos! Na pele de um de 4 mercenários com capacidades RPG, equipa-te com baziliões de armas e enfrenta o planeta de Pandora.

Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG game about an extraordinary family of heroes. Lead the Bergsons, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for?

DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE revisits famous battles from the series through your custom Avatar and other classic characters. New features include the mysterious Toki Toki City, new gameplay mechanics, new animations and many other amazing features!

ofertas.nome: TT Isle Of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
ofertas.descricao: Um circuito icônico para fãs de motociclismo. 200 km de estradas abertas para praticar. Física desafiadora. Uma simulação para os melhores motociclistas.

Trilhe o seu caminho para um império de serviços. Suje as suas mãos em um jogo de simulação altamente realista, com muita atenção aos detalhes. Faça uma visita a uma nova casa de leilões e compre carros em várias condições.

The ultimate DARKSIDERS II experience! 1080p native resolution. Reworked and tuned game balancing and loot distribution. Improved Graphic Render Engine for even higher visual quality, lighting and shadows. Improved and reworked level, character and environment graphics.

Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer! Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges. Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles. Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.
DARKSIDERS: GENESIS dá aos jogadores o seu primeiro olhar ao mundo do DARKSIDERS antes dos eventos do jogo original e introduz o cavaleiro STRIFE.

Frostpunk is the first society survival game. As the ruler of the last city on Earth, it is your duty to manage both its citizens and infrastructure. What decisions will you make to ensure your society's survival? What will you do when pushed to breaking point? Who will you become in the process?

Um aventura tropical em mundo aberto. Escala, plana, nada e viaja por um arquipélago deslumbrante com o teu barco neste sandbox com mecânicas de jogo baseadas na física. Controla qualquer animal ou objeto que encontres e dá espetáculo com o teu ukulele totalmente funcional.

Num mundo dividido entre o encanto da natureza e a invasão fria das máquinas, uma menina e sua amiga devem confiar no vínculo entre elas para sobreviver e proteger aquilo que mais prezam. Sua história de esperança, perda e amor marcará você por muito tempo após o fim da jornada.

Plague Inc: Evolved é uma mistura única de estratégia e simulação terrivelmente realística. Seu patógeno acabou de infectar o 'Paciente Zero' - agora você deve trazer o fim da história da humanidade evoluindo uma praga mortal e global enquanto se adapta contra tudo que a humanidade pode fazer para se defender.
Launch into the Borderlands universe and shoot ‘n’ loot your way through a brand new adventure that rockets you onto Pandora’s moon in Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel!

Jogo de sobrevivência na primeira pessoa num cenário pós-apocalíptico em mundo aberto, à mercê de mortos-vivos esfomeados. Percorre uma cidade devastada por um vírus epidémico. Procura mantimentos, fabrica armas e enfrenta a horda de infetados.

Spiritfarer® é um acolhedor jogo de gestão sobre a morte. És a timoneira do ferry dos mortos e terás de cuidar dos teus espíritos amigos, melhorar o teu ferry para explorar o mundo e guiar os espíritos até os libertares no pós-vida. Inclui o jogo base e três grandes atualizações de conteúdos.
Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD is a “multi-ending ADV” depicting daily life with “OMGkawaiiAngel”, a young girl with a rather extreme need for approval attempting to become the #1 “Internet Angel” (streamer).
MMORPG full of details that create a unique immersion and the spirit of adventure! Play your role in the life-filled medieval world controlled by players.
Create, discover, and download new player-created maps, scenarios, interfaces, and more!

Late Shift é um FMV que envolve um thriller policial de alto risco . Forçado a participar num assalto brutal em Londres, vais ter de escolher a tua própria aventura nesta experiência cinematográfica interativa com um enredo que se vai adaptando e que te leva a um de sete finais diferentes.
Regressa a uma Terra apocalíptica no Darksiders III, um ""hack-n-slash"" de ação e aventura onde os jogadores assumem o papel de FURY na sua demanda para perseguir e eliminar os Sete Pecados Mortais.

A porta da sua carreira de ladrão está à sua espera! Basta arrancar a fechadura com um pé de cabra e forçar a sua entrada. Aprenda habilidades, coleccione ferramentas e torne-se um mestre do ofício de ladrão!
Human Fall Flat é um hilariante jogo de plataformas em paisagens flutuantes para jogar a solo ou com até 8 jogadores online. Novos níveis grátis ajudam a recompensar a sua comunidade vibrante.
Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

Warhammer 40,000: Gladius – Relics of War brings you to a world of terror and violence. Four factions will engage in a brutal war for dominance over the planet’s resources. In the first turn-based 4X strategy game set in Warhammer 40,000 you will lead one of four unique factions.

Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?

ofertas.nome: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
ofertas.descricao: Embark on a journey to a realm overrun by demons in a new epic RPG from the creators of the critically acclaimed Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Explore the nature of good and evil, learn the true cost of power, and rise as a Mythic Hero capable of deeds beyond mortal expectations.

O “shooter-looter” original regressa com quadriliões de armas numa nova aventura caótica! Descobre novos mundos e inimigos na pele de um de quatro novos Vault Hunters com diferentes habilidades e estilos de personalização.
Concebe, mantém e gere uma instalação hospitalar de alta tecnologia, tirando o máximo partido dos recursos limitados e transformando curas em dinheiro. Consegues equilibrar as contas e os urinóis?
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

ofertas.nome: AVIÃOZINHO DO TRÁFICO 3:ABRI UM PORTAL PRO INFERNO NA FAVELA TENTANDO REVIVER MIT AIA E PRECISO FECHAR
ofertas.descricao: A BRAZILIAN BOOMER SHOOTER GAME MADE USING THE ID TECH 2 ENGINE! SHOOT, JUMP, EMBARK ON A JOURNEY THROUGHOUT THE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE BRAZIL!

Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 permite-te lutar com o maior e melhor elenco de personagens de combate de sempre! Escolhe os teus Brawlers favoritos, domina as suas habilidades, e usa os novos e poderosos Supers para desferir o golpe final, na companhia de amigos ou numa campanha roguelike a solo!
London, 1918. You are newly-turned Vampyr Dr. Jonathan Reid. As a doctor, you must find a cure to save the city’s flu-ravaged citizens. As a Vampyr, you are cursed to feed on those you vowed to heal.
Follow the grim tale of young Amicia and her little brother Hugo, in a heartrending journey through the darkest hours of history.
Master realistic drift physics, tune 120+ cars and drift online with up to 16 players across platforms. Compete in TOP-32, build unique setups and explore hundreds of community-made Workshop maps.

Crie e libere no mundo aberto de Trailmakers. Desbloqueie sua própria habilidade para criar e inovar em Trailmakers. Uma sandbox de engenharia inédita abastecida pela comunidade de jogos mais criativa do mundo.

Grow an ever-expanding fungal network in this relaxing incremental exploration game. Discover hidden resources, cultivate mushrooms that automate your production, and evolve your mycelium into a self-sustaining underground empire.

Experience the ultimate WWII RTS platform with COH2 and its standalone expansions. This package includes the base game, which you can then upgrade by purchasing The Western Front Armies, Ardennes Assault and/or The British Forces. More info in the "About This Game" section below.

PEAK é um jogo cooperativo de escalada, no qual o mais pequeno erro pode ser desastroso. Quer estejas a solo ou com um grupo de escuteiros perdidos, a única esperança de fuga da ilha misteriosa é escalar a montanha no centro. Tens o que é preciso para chegar ao CUME?

Assassin's Creed™ is the next-gen game developed by Ubisoft Montreal that redefines the action genre. While other games claim to be next-gen with impressive graphics and physics, Assassin's Creed merges technology, game design, theme and emotions into a world where you instigate chaos and become a vulnerable, yet powerful, agent of...
It’s time to join the Brotherhood.
An epic story of family, vengeance and conspiracy set in the pristine, yet brutal, backdrop of a Renaissance Italy. New low price!

ofertas.nome: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves
ofertas.descricao: 26 years on, a brand-new entry in the Fatal Fury series is set to arrive on the scene! FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves features a unique art style that stimulates the senses and an innovative REV System that supercharges the excitement. Here, at long last, a new legend is about to unfold…

The world has been thrown into chaos by an ancient evil from another dimension. As one of the last remnants of humanity, you must set out alone or alongside up to two other survivors to face down hordes of deadly enemies to try to carve a foothold, rebuild, and retake what was lost.
Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig for treasures, unlock upgrades, get help from friendly pals and flip tools to dig up mountains of dirt. Will you find out what secrets are hidden beneath the dirt?

ofertas.nome: AVIÃOZINHO DO TRÁFICO PRÉ 4: SOBRARAM DEMONIOS DO PORTAL PRO INFERNO NA FAVELA QUE ABRI E AGORA TENHO QUE SALVAR OS MAMADAS DO RONALDO
ofertas.descricao: THE STANDALONE SEQUEL OF THE BRAZILIAN BOOMER SHOOTER GAME MADE USING THE ID TECH 2 ENGINE! SHOOT, JUMP, DOUBLE JUMP AND DASH! EMBARK ON A JOURNEY THROUGHOUT THE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE BRAZIL!

Hydroneer é um jogo sandbox sobre mineração onde você cava a procura de ouro e outros recursos para obter lucro e aprimorar sua mineração. Construa uma base de operações, forge armas, vá pescar, e cave fundo!

In this city-building game, you will lead a group of survivors in their search for a new home. Manipulate the landscape, manage limited supplies, plant crops, hunt wildlife, gather resources, and develop trade routes to build a bustling and unique town.

A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

A Little to the Left é um jogo de puzzles fofinho onde tens de classificar, empilhar e organizar objetos. Mas fica atento ao gato maquiavélico com um gostinho para o caos! Espreita este divertido e intuitivo jogo de puzzles com mais de 100 desarrumações satisfatórias para resolver.

ofertas.nome: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
ofertas.descricao: Estão prontos, miúdos? O clássico de culto está de volta e recriado em todo o seu esplendor “spongetástico”! Joga com SpongeBob, Patrick e Sandy e mostra ao Plankton que o crime compensa ainda menos do que trabalhar para Mr. Krabs.

In this game, meet a mysterious girl who demands you use an "Anomalous Coffee Machine". Type any word to create a drink, then choose who drinks: her or you. Some cups whisper, some scream, some change what you are. She watches quietly, like she already knows what you’ll choose. Now it's your turn!

The ultimate railway hobby for more than 15 years! From historic steam locomotives to modern high-speed and heavy freight trains, and routes around the world, Train Simulator Classic is the simulation made by railfans for railfans.

Killer Frequency é uma aventura de terror na primeira pessoa que te coloca na pele de Forrest Nash, um locutor de rádio noturna cujos ouvintes estão a ser perseguidos por um assassino. Resolve puzzles, salva vidas e gere os painéis de controlo, tudo ao som de uma jukebox de canções dos anos 80!

Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Enhanced Plus Edition is the first isometric party-based cRPG set in the Pathfinder fantasy universe. Enjoy a classic RPG experience inspired by games like Baldur's Gate, Fallout 1 and 2 and Arcanum. Explore and conquer the Stolen Lands and make them your kingdom!

A horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.
Ezio Auditore walks in the footsteps of the legendary mentor Altair, on a dangerous journey of discovery and revelation.

Introducing Assassin’s Creed® Rogue, the darkest chapter in the Assassin’s Creed franchise yet. As Shay, you will experience the slow transformation from Assassin to Assassin Hunter. Follow your own creed and set off on an extraordinary journey through New York City, the wild river valley, and far away to the icy cold waters of the North...

MY HERO ONE'S JUSTICE 2, a sequela do fantástico jogo de luta em 3D MY HERO ONE'S JUSTICE, faz a sua estreia! Tira todo o partido das características das personagens enquanto participas em batalhas épicas em arenas gigantescas!

Thymesia é um desafiante RPG de ação com combates velozes e um complexo sistema de armas portadoras de peste. Num reino onde a morte se propaga, encarna o misterioso "Corvus" e persegue os teus inimigos, empunha o poder da doença e descobre a verdade entre as tuas próprias memórias.

A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

ofertas.nome: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV STEAM EDITION
ofertas.descricao: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV finally hits STEAM! KOF XIV is back with its classic 2D gameplay and "3-on-3 TEAM BATTLE" game system but evolved to 3D! 58 charismatic fighters are about to clash in this new chapter of KOF!

Discover the magic and lore of the Alps in this acclaimed Action Adventure. Forge relationships with locals to help you solve puzzles, battle monsters and uncover secrets of the legendary Dungeons of Hinterberg!

ofertas.nome: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
ofertas.descricao: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

De robe brilhante e forças encantadas, é tempo de construir torres reforçadas! Empilhe blocos nesta terra louvável - qual torre de fábula será mais estável? Batalhe contra amigos e alcance a fama, neste jogo de grupo onde a física clama.

Sort Them Ducks é um simulador de organização acolhedor no qual organiza mais de 4000 patinhos de borracha únicos nas prateleiras corretas. Desfrute do processo satisfatório de transformar uma loja de patinhos desarrumada numa coleção perfeitamente organizada, ao seu próprio ritmo.
Scam Line is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory

Saqueia, dispara e ceifa hordas de zombies neste bullet heaven alucinante. Faz-te à estrada, decide quando extrair, organiza a mochila em builds que rebentam com o jogo e sente aquele gozo da gestão de inventário quando o novo espólio encaixa na perfeição.
An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.

AVISO: Este jogo contém trocadilhos, piadas do tio do pavê, minijogos-arcade-tipo-flappy-bird, quebra da 4ª parede e é uma indireta diretíssima a esses RPGs excessivamente sérios e que demandam muito esforço. Não jogue se você odeia DIVERSÃO.

DJMAX RESPECT V is the latest installment from the creators of the critically acclaimed rhythm game franchise ‘DJMAX.’ Experience tracks from popular artists such as Marshmello, Porter Robinson, and Yukika, exclusive Full HD Music Videos, online multiplayer, new game modes, and more!

OneShot is a surreal top down Puzzle/Adventure game with unique gameplay capabilities. You are to guide a child through a mysterious world on a mission to restore its long-dead sun. The world knows you exist.
Scorn is an atmospheric first-person horror adventure game set in a nightmarish universe of odd forms and somber tapestry.
De que serve ter amigos se não for para jogar golfe... With Your Friends? Vale tudo nestes campos de minigolfe e a ação é rápida e entusiasmante para um máximo de 12 jogadores em simultâneo!

Aliens: Fireteam Elite é um jogo de sobrevivência co-op na 3.ª pessoa, passado no icónico universo de Alien. Enfrenta hordas variadas de Xenopmorphs, personaliza a tua personagem e equipamento e sobe de nível enquanto tentas conter esta ameaça.

Inscryption é uma sombria odisseia pavimentada por cartas que mescla roguelike de construção de baralhos, quebra-cabeças no estilo de "escape rooms" e horror psicológico para criar uma amálgama sanguinolenta. Ainda mais obscuros são os segredos das cartas...
Enter the fractured psyche of Bruce Wayne and discover the powerful and far-reaching consequences of your choices as the Dark Knight.
